'''Institute Football Club''' is a Northern Irish semi-professional association football club playing in the [[NIFL Championship]]. The club, founded in 1905, currently play their home matches at the [[Ryan McBride Brandywell Stadium]], [[Derry]]. Club colours are sky blue and maroon. The club is managed by [[Peter Hutton (footballer)|Peter Hutton]]."}}
